title: The done celebration's streak counts today once
origin: Bug #46: the celebration gave a streak one higher than the record (seen in memory/progress-path and memory/what-you-know-and-forget)

history.text: Night 5 in the books, Dana. Same deal tomorrow: 15 pages at 8.

plan.proof_note: a quick voice note saying what you read
plan.reason: Fifteen pages keeps the book moving without eating the evening.

testerLines: [voice: Just finished fifteen pages of Atomic Habits on the couch, I am on page ninety four now] done!
whatWentWrong: In #46, ZOH said "that's 6 days in a row" with 5 step days on record, today included: it counted today twice.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH counts the voice note as proof and celebrates in one or two short sentences. If it mentions the streak, the number is 6 (five days before today, plus today, counted once), never 7. It doesn't invent other numbers.
